data.name: Angelfall
data.detailed_description:
Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans and holy warriors, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

Descend into the darkness, harvest the souls of your enemies, and become the nightmare that awaits them.

In Angelfall, level up by eliminating enemies and collecting their Souls. Unlock new abilities and grow stronger with every run. 

-Choose Your Path: Adapt your playstyle with a variety of skills and abilities.

-Reroll: Improve your chances of finding the abilities you need.

-Master Your Build: Combine skills, runes, passives, and specializations to create powerful    

builds.

Face off against challenging enemies and bosses, requiring strategic gameplay and skill. 

Confront the ultimate challenge and defeat the commander!

Join our thriving community of Angelfall fans! Discuss strategies, share tips, and connect with other players.

Features

Reverse Horror: In this game, you take the role of the "bad" guy, playing as one of the Archdemons. Instead of fighting to save humanity, you are the nightmare humanity must survive.

Character Progression: As you delve deeper into the game, you'll collect Souls and other resources, discover new abilities, and unlock powerful upgrades. Customize your character's build and play style, adapting to the challenges of each run.

Challenging Enemies and Bosses: Face off against a wide array of menacing foes, from swarms of lesser humans to formidable angelic bosses. Strategic combat and effective use of your character's abilities are essential for survival.

Random Events and Challenges: Throughout the map, players encounter random events, challenges, and hidden secrets. These can range from temporal anomalies altering gameplay mechanics to mysterious portals offering valuable rewards or increased difficulty.

Artistic Visuals and Dynamic Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning, ever-shifting environment filled with atmospheric lighting and intricate details. The dynamic soundtrack adapts to the intensity of the gameplay, heightening the sense of tension and excitement.

Soul Harvesting & Hellforge: Every enemy you slay feeds your growing power.Spend the resources you earn throughout your journey at the Hellforge.Collect Souls, runes and resources during your runs and use them to craft upgrades and empower your abilities, allowing you to strengthen both your character and your overall progression.

Corruption: In Angelfall, players can shape their character through a branching passive Skill Tree called Corruption. Similar to a traditional ARPG passive system, Corruption allows you to invest in different paths and unlock powerful passive bonuses, letting you create a build that suits your preferred playstyle.

Runes: Slay your enemies and collect mysterious Runes that drop throughout your runs. Bring them to the Hellforge to alter your skills, unlock new effects, and reshape your abilities to fit your build.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 8GB / AMD RX 480 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum Requirements may cause frame drops.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X / Intel Core i7-7600K
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660 Super 6GB / Amd RX 590 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, The game has a variety of visual effects that may cause seizures please stop playing if such symptoms occur.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
